summary: Sportradar Group AG filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amendment to its existing €220M revolving credit facility, increasing total commitments to €250M. The RCF remains undrawn and bears interest at EURIBOR/Term SOFR/SONIA plus a margin between 1.50% and 2.25% based on a senior secured net leverage ratchet, with a commitment fee of 0.35%. The amendment also updates customary covenants, including a springing financial covenant requiring a senior secured net leverage ratio not exceeding 6.50x. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation transaction or recapitalization. No actionable event triggers a special-situation classification.
